markdown:
For readers researching the best forex brokers in Pakistan, **PMEX futures and offshore retail forex/CFDs are different services**. The [SBP’s Circular Letter 08 of 2022](https://www.sbp.org.pk/circulars/epd-circular-letter-no-08-of-2022) states that direct or indirect foreign-exchange remittances to the covered offshore trading platforms through any payment channel are not allowed.

The supplied brief names **H.G Markets, Floret Capitals, AKD Securities, JS Global Capital and Brown Bull Commodities** as domestic-market research leads. Their current licences, exact legal identities and currency-contract availability are not established here. These are not five verified retail spot-forex recommendations.

## Quick comparison

| Name supplied | Research focus | Evidence still needed |
|---|---|---|
| H.G Markets | Domestic futures brokerage | Current legal company, licence, PMEX membership and product schedule |
| Floret Capitals | Domestic futures account comparison | Exact legal-name match, current permissions and contracts |
| AKD Securities | Securities versus futures services | Relevant company, account and futures permissions |
| JS Global Capital | Domestic brokerage product access | Actual company, exchange role and offered contracts |
| Brown Bull Commodities | Commodity/futures brokerage | Current company, permissions and available currency contracts |

The brief attributes these names to August/September 2026 activity reports, but the reports were not supplied. Trading activity would not establish current licensing, safety or suitability even if confirmed.

**Account-link status:** Individual company application addresses have not been verified. Check the [PMEX broker directory](https://pmex.com.pk/broker/) and independently confirm the destination before sharing documents or money. No affiliate tracking is active.

## How we selected these brokers

We retained the five domestic-market names from the brief rather than replacing them with offshore platforms. The names are research leads, not a tested ranking or fresh licence verification.

Check the [SECP capital-market registers](https://www.secp.gov.pk/data-and-statistics/capital-markets/) and PMEX membership information for:

- The exact legal company and current futures-broker permission.
- The firm's exchange status and any restrictions.
- The specific contract and account category offered.
- Commission, exchange/clearing charges and margin terms.
- Client-money arrangements and the complaint route.

An old register or activity report is not a current licence guarantee. No funded-account or withdrawal tests were performed for this guide.

## Forex trading rules in Pakistan

The SBP circular discusses offshore foreign-exchange, margin-trading and CFD platforms. It says buying the covered services violates the cited foreign-exchange rules, and directs authorised dealers to stop related payments. A small payment, intermediary or different payment channel does not establish permission.

| Issue | Practical distinction |
|---|---|
| Offshore retail forex/CFDs | Do not treat foreign licensing as permission under Pakistani rules |
| PMEX futures | Exchange-listed contracts through appropriately authorised brokers are a separate service |
| Broker role | Verify relevant SECP licensing and PMEX status |
| Product access | A futures broker does not necessarily offer every currency contract |
| Overseas payment | A bank transfer completing does not make a prohibited purpose permissible |

This page offers no funding workaround. Seek current authoritative guidance on the exact product and transaction.

## What “best forex brokers in Pakistan” should mean

First establish a permitted service and an appropriately authorised provider. Then compare the actual contract's liquidity, tick value, expiry, margin and complete costs. Futures contracts should not be modelled as identical to rolling spot CFDs.

Our [platform guide](/insights/best-platforms-for-day-trading) explains usability checks. The [forex calculator](/tools/forex-calculator) and [profit calculator](/tools/forex-profit-calculator) use their stated assumptions; they do not establish PMEX contract specifications or transaction permission.

## Investor protection: what it covers

| Topic | What to establish | What not to assume |
|---|---|---|
| Client money | Approved beneficiary and handling arrangements | Payments to a representative's personal account are acceptable |
| Margin/liability | Liquidation and deficit terms for the actual contract | Losses cannot exceed an initial deposit |
| Complaints | Company, exchange and regulatory routes | Regulatory status insures market losses |

No universal compensation payout or negative-balance guarantee is established here. Read the actual company and exchange terms.

## Payment methods in Pakistan

Confirm the permitted domestic product, legal beneficiary, account ownership and applicable payment process before depositing. PMEX account procedures are not a route around the SBP offshore restrictions.

Do not send money to personal accounts or rely on wallet/crypto intermediaries to make an otherwise prohibited transfer permissible. Our [position size calculator](/tools/forex-position-size-calculator) illustrates risk inputs; confirm actual contract size and tick value separately.

## Red flags to avoid

- Offshore services described as permitted solely because they hold a foreign licence.
- Activity rankings presented as current licensing evidence.
- Guaranteed profits or pressure to deposit.
- An unverified website, legal company or personal payment beneficiary.

## FAQs

### Can Pakistani residents fund offshore forex or CFD platforms?

The cited SBP circular states that direct or indirect foreign-exchange remittances to the covered overseas forex, margin-trading and CFD platforms through any payment channel are not allowed. Do not treat an accepted application as permission.

### Are PMEX futures the same as retail spot forex?

No. Exchange-listed futures have their own contracts, settlement, margin and broker permissions. A PMEX broker's existence does not establish that every currency contract is available or suitable.

### Which broker is best for beginners in Pakistan?

No tested beginner ranking is established here. Verify the exact SECP/PMEX company and permitted product first, then assess fees, platform support, risk disclosures and complaint arrangements.

## Final recommendation

Start with permitted domestic products and verified official records rather than offshore forex promotions. The five supplied names need current identity, licence, contract and application checks. Essential savings should not be exposed to leveraged trading risk.
